prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling hospital corridor filled with distinct figures and objects. On the far left, a nurse in blue scrubs stands holding a clipboard. Next to her, a patient in a striped gown sits on a wheelchair. A brown leather bag rests on the floor beside the wheelchair. In the center foreground, a doctor in a white coat points at an x-ray film held by an intern in green scrubs. The intern looks at the film intently. Behind them, a tall IV stand holds a clear bag of saline. To the right of the IV stand, an elderly woman in a floral dress walks with a wooden cane. A young boy in a yellow shirt runs past her, looking back over his shoulder. Further down the hall on the right, a security guard in a black uniform leans against the wall. Next to the guard, a potted fern sits in a white ceramic pot. Above the fern, a digital clock displays the time. In the background center, a receptionist behind a desk types on a keyboard. A telephone sits on the desk next to the keyboard. A visitor in a denim jacket stands near the desk, talking to the receptionist. A child in a pink dress holds a teddy bear while standing next to the visitor. At the far end of the corridor, a janitor pushes a cleaning cart. A mop bucket is attached to the side of the cart. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no fire or smoke present. There is no outdoor scenery visible through any windows.
